T1_triangle_coordinate_sufficiency.statement: For a nondegenerate labeled three-point Euclidean configuration modulo common translations/rotations, three pair distances determine the congruence class.

T2_common_rigid_motion_quotient.statement: Common Euclidean rigid motion preserves all three pair distances, so the relational base quotients common ambient motion.

T3_shared_resolution_not_scalar.statement: Retain a graph-valued Resolution state at each recursive depth; scalar depth is only an index/summary.

T4_five_dimensional_carrier.statement: 3 Euclidean relational coordinates + 1 recursive Resolution coordinate + 1 History/order coordinate yields a 5D carrier without treating every graph label as a new geometric dimension.

T5_bandwidth_system_object.statement: System Bandwidth is modeled as the admissible relational transformation family of the whole three-ball object, not an arithmetic sum of component bandwidths.

T6_torus_requirement.statement: Pure three-ball Euclidean relational geometry does not force a torus. A torus re-enters only if cyclic Resolution/phase coordinates are independently present.
